why: Measured on 2 October 2026 on dev at fb8abba with no change applied, by lane F of the server split (PRDCT-3154): the baseline run on a laptop (1797 passed, 25 failed) and the first CI run on macos-latest (1797 passed, 28 failed), 15 failures in common. `specs` lists the checks that failed on both, by name: deterministic on dev, cause not investigated by that lane. `unstable` lists the specs that crashed before finishing on both (a crash can never be a known check: it would hide every regression before it) and the specs whose failures differed between the two machines or between two runs on one; their results are counted and printed as UNSTABLE and are not a gate until the spec is fixed (PRDCT-1762 names the boot race behind several of them). A listed check that passes, or an unstable spec that passes in full, is reported by run.mjs so this file shrinks. On 5 October 2026 (lane F round 3) empty-group and hidden-session-restore joined the unstable specs: they fail on both machines with the same boot-race shape (a group created through MCP in the first seconds after the page loads is never drawn: at 2 s it is not, at 3 s it is, in both modes; whether the boot restore wipes it or it is never added was not established, PRDCT-1762), in-process and attached alike, and pass with a 12 s settle instead of 4 s; measured under a load average of 70 to 100. On 7 October 2026 (lane B of wave 2, PRDCT-3240) multi-window-migration joined the unstable specs: its four app-side checks (the two workspaces’ group lists, the group count, the four seeded survivors adopted) failed three times on ee325bc on 6 October, every time with three suites running on the machine, and the spec passed 21 of 21 run alone on lane A’s bare 031afc9, on 61d3641, on b85664f and on ee325bc at load 20, while the verifier of the same lane, run alone on 5bc4efe at load 58 to 104, got 4 checks red then 1, and 1 on 031afc9 bare; the same boot-race shape as the two specs above (the restore and the adoption in the first seconds after boot, PRDCT-1762). On 8 October 2026 (lane C of wave 3, PRDCT-3293, the sessions on the separate server) launcher joined the unstable specs for the attached mode: its two checks after a launch (the terminal's tab drawn at the workspace root, the remembered agent after a restart) went red in two full attached runs at load averages above 60 and passed 13 of 13 alone and 35 of 35 beside its predecessor at load 20, on ce071a3; the same boot-race shape as the specs above, the window reading its first answers before the attached server is announced. On 10 October 2026 (lane A of wave 4, PRDCT-1762) the harness started waiting on the window's boot mark instead of a fixed 4 s, and empty-group, hidden-session-restore, launcher, multi-window-core, multi-window-migration and multi-window-move passed in full in both modes on the first run of the fixed harness (381 passed, in-process and attached alike), so they left this list; group-dissolve, multi-window-routing and codex-chat-tab-restore still failed the same checks in both modes on that run and stay until they are understood.
